subject: Intro: Redwood x CloudMed (AWS co-sell interest)
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudmed.io>

Cc: CloudMed Ops <ops@cloudmed.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood x CloudMed (AWS co-sell interest)

Hi Naomi + Ben,

Quick intro — I'm Oliver, Head of Platform at CloudMed. We run a clinical-claims automation product and are evaluating an LLM inference partner to run sensitive workloads in AWS (HIPAA-adjacent). Our goals are predictable latency at scale and tighter cost controls for peak batch windows. AWS recommended Redwood for co-sell enablement and marketplace listing.

High-level asks:
- Intro to Redwood’s AWS co-sell / marketplace motion and key contacts
- Rough timeline for a joint account plan + procurement path (marketplace vs direct)
- Any security prerequisites or docs we should prepare (SOC2 / data residency notes)

We're US-based (hosted in us-east-1). Key internal stakeholders: myself, ops@cloudmed.io, and our Head of Security (stated below in next message). Would appreciate a quick 30-min sync next week to align.

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform, CloudMed
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudmed.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x CloudMed (AWS co-sell interest)

Hi Oliver — great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the clear ask. I’m Naomi on our Strategic Partnerships / AWS engagement team.

We can absolutely support a co-sell path with AWS and help map the marketplace vs direct procurement tradeoffs for your procurement/compliance needs. Before the call, can you share:
- Primary use case (batch vs streaming inference, typical seq lengths, concurrency targets)
- Whether you need dedicated capacity (SLA) or are evaluating hosted API first
- A contact at CloudMed Security (name + email) so we can pre-send our security checklist

Proposed windows for a 30-min intro next week (PST):
- Tue 3 Aug 10:00–10:30
- Wed 4 Aug 14:00–14:30
- Thu 5 Aug 09:00–09:30

I’ve looped in Ben (our Marketplace lead) and Laura (Solutions/SE) who will join the call. I’ll attach a short intake questionnaire and a draft mutual action plan we use for AWS co-sell handoffs.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head, AWS Partnerships — Redwood Inference
